metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description:
Captures war as two children slowly running out of everything. A brother tries to keep his little sister fed and cheerful in Kobe, 1945, making worse decisions out of pride.

A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description:
Captures fame eating a person's grip on which self is hers. A pop idol turned actress, a stalker, and a fan site narrating her life in first person — the animated form is what makes the slippage work.

A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

metas.name: Waltz with Bashir
metas.description:
Captures a soldier's memory with a hole in it. Animated interviews as the director tries to recover what he did in Beirut in 1982, ending with footage that breaks the animation open.

An Israeli film director interviews fellow veterans of the 1982 invasion of Lebanon to reconstruct his own memories of his term of service in that conflict.

metas.name: Flee
metas.description:
Captures telling a hidden life story for the first time. An animated documentary about a refugee from Afghanistan settled in Denmark, recounting flight, family separation and a secret he has kept from everyone.

A man looks back over his life as he grapples with a painful secret he has kept hidden for 20 years, one that threatens to derail the life he has built for himself and his soon to be husband.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
metas.description:
Captures what a comic book actually feels like to read, in motion. Also a genuinely good story about a kid learning that anyone can wear the mask, by failing at it a lot.

Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Princess Mononoke
metas.description:
Captures an ecological war with no pure side. Iron Town needs the forest cut to survive; the forest gods need the humans gone; a prince cursed by a dying god tries to see with unclouded eyes.

After a deadly curse forces him from home, young warrior Ashitaka journeys west and is drawn into a conflict between ancient forest spirits, an iron town, and a wolf-raised girl.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description:
Captures decency as something contagious. A bear framed for stealing the pop-up book he wanted to buy his aunt, sent to prison — and the prison improves because he is in it.

Paddington, now happily settled with the Brown family and a popular member of the local community, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy's 100th birthday, only for the gift to be stolen.

metas.name: Paprika
metas.description:
Captures dreams invading waking life as a parade. A device that lets therapists enter dreams is stolen, and reality dissolves into a marching band of refrigerators and dolls; Inception's debt is on screen.

When a machine that allows therapists to enter their patients' dreams is stolen, all hell breaks loose. Only a young female therapist, Paprika, can stop it.

metas.name: It's Such a Beautiful Day
metas.description:
Captures a mind coming apart, drawn with stick figures. Hertzfeldt narrates a man with a failing brain in three chapters — funny, fragmented, and by the end genuinely cosmic.

Bill struggles to put together his shattered psyche, in this new feature film version of Don Hertzfeldt's animated short film trilogy.

metas.name: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
metas.description:
Captures joy being disciplined out of a girl. A bamboo cutter raises a moon princess and watches court life sand down the wild child she was, until the watercolour lines themselves start to run.

Kaguya is a beautiful young woman coveted by five nobles. To try to avoid marrying a stranger she doesn't love, she sends her suitors on seemingly impossible tasks. But she will have to face her fate and punishment for her choices.

metas.name: Wolfwalkers
metas.description:
Captures the wild being hunted in the name of order. Kilkenny, 1650: a hunter's daughter befriends a girl who becomes a wolf in her sleep, and Cartoon Saloon's hand-drawn forest keeps breaking out of the town's straight lines.

A young apprentice hunter and her father journey to Ireland to help wipe out the last wolf pack. But everything changes when she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.

metas.name: Tower
metas.description:
Captures how people inside an event remember it — partial, sensory, nothing like the news summary. The 1966 UT Austin sniper massacre retold in rotoscoped animation from survivors' memories, switching to real footage only at the end.

Animation, testimony, and archival footage combine to relate the events of August 1, 1966 when a gunman opened fire from the University of Texas clock tower, killing 16 people.

metas.name: Tale of Tales
metas.description:
Captures folk memory itself — images from childhood, war and lullaby sharing one continuous dream. Norstein's 29-minute animation drifts through layers of cut-out, glass and mist: a little wolf, a minotaur, tango dancers, soldiers leaving for the front.

Distant, well-worn memories of childhood are inhabited by a little gray wolf. Through astonishing imagery, the memory of all of Russia is depicted.

metas.name: Alice
metas.description:
Captures the folk tale as a child's-eye inventory of a household's dangerous things. Švankmajer's Alice moves through a Wonderland of taxidermy, bones and jam jars of pins, stop-motion objects that genuinely threaten her — Carroll's dream rebuilt from junk drawers.

A surrealistic revision of Alice in Wonderland.
